title: Objectwise finite proper projection formula
statement: For a finite commutative ring Λ and a proper morphism g : Z ⟶ Y of schemes, every component (((rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap (ModuleCat Λ) g).app M).app L) on the ordinary unbounded derived categories of small-etale Λ-module sheaves is an isomorphism.

proof.text: A finite commutative ring is torsion, since the powers of its additive unit eventually repeat and a positive integer annihilates every element.

Apply the unbounded proper projection formula for torsion coefficients to the two chosen derived-category objects. Exact inverse image on etale module sheaves identifies the derived upper-star tensor comparison with the canonical projection component; the adjoint-of-counit definitions give the displayed component.
